title: Edge deployment friction map and prospectivity probe
creator: Aisha Kumar
description:
Objective: produce a pragmatic, prioritized map of deployment friction across models and customer archetypes (edge, hosted, dedicated, private). Outcome should inform product routing policies, Dedicated procurement guidance, and a short engineering intake for reducing integration overheads.

Why now: Sales & Solutions reports increased friction when proposing low-latency edge RAG solutions in APAC and regulated verticals. We need an evidence-backed prioritization to decide which model-variant integrations and quantization investments buy the most reduction in procurement + latency friction.

Scope: 30 model variants (open and partner), 3 customer archetypes (startups, mid-market SaaS, regulated enterprise), 4 regions (NA, EU, APAC, LatAm). Focus on non-functional frictions: latency/SLO fit, quantization compatibility, packaging/ONNX/torchscript readiness, licensing/licensing red flags, procurement SLAs, and deployment automation gaps.
acceptance_criteria: 20+ customer or solutions-engineering interviews recorded and summarized
Telemetry crosswalk that maps 60%+ of active requests to archetype latency bands and deployment modes
Prospectivity score produced for 30 model variants with top-10 prioritized for engineering intake
Concrete routing/fallback recommendation for top-5 customer-impact pairs with estimated cost/latency delta
tasks: Define signal model for prospectivity (latency sensitivity, procurement friction, integration cost, fallback maturity)
Instrument telemetry query to extract per-model 95th-tail latency by region and request size
Run microbenchmarks on representative hardware for shortlisted models (fp16/ggml/4-bit quant profiles)
Interview 10 field engineers and 12 prospects/customers across archetypes
Synthesize friction map (Miro) and scoring sheet (Drive) and review with ENG/SE/GTN
deliverables: Friction map Miro board (deployment-mode x friction-type heatmap)
Prospectivity scoring spreadsheet with weights and per-model scores
Top-10 prioritized model-integration tickets for ENG (engineer intake templates)
Short playbook for Solutions on recommending fallbacks during sales conversations
Executive one-pager summarizing recommended capacity/quant investment decisions
